relationships.subject: spontaneous opioid withdrawal
relationships.evidence_quote: Brain slices prepared 24 h following the last morphine injection showed increases in ACC L5 thick-tufted PyN-intrinsic membrane excitability

relationships.subject: ACC
relationships.evidence_quote: chemogenetic inhibition of the ACC blocked opioid-induced withdrawal and withdrawal-induced mechanical hypersensitivity

key_findings: Spontaneous opioid withdrawal increases excitability and membrane resistance and reduces IH in ACC L5 thick-tufted PyNs of male mice, with no change in D1 thin-tufted PyNs.
Chemogenetic inhibition of the ACC blocks withdrawal behaviors and withdrawal-induced mechanical hypersensitivity.
